title: Shoplifting Arrest
summary: Grading depends on the full retail value.

steps.text: Confirm what security saw: selection, concealment, passing the last point of sale
Get the full retail value of all items
Collect video and the store's written statement
Grade by value: DP under $200; 4th degree $200-$500; 3rd degree $500 to $75,000; 2nd degree $75,000+
Return or photograph merchandise per store and agency policy

note: Follow your department's policy and current AG directives. Not yet verified against official sources.
